scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API,WORKER -c white,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @wechatsend/frontend" "npm run start:dev -w @wechatsend/backend" "npm run worker:dev -w @wechatsend/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wechatsend/backend && npm run build -w @wechatsend/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wechatsend/backend && npm run typecheck -w @wechatsend/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wechatsend/backend && npm run test -w @wechatsend/frontend
